name: discord-voice-control
title: Discord Voice Control
description: Toggle Discord mute and deafen from Raycast without leaving your current app. Local-only, best-effort.
author: paulchris_yeow

commands.name: toggle-mute
commands.title: Toggle Mute
commands.subtitle: Discord
commands.description: Send the Discord toggle-mute shortcut (best-effort; cannot confirm the resulting state).

commands.name: toggle-deafen
commands.title: Toggle Deafen
commands.subtitle: Discord
commands.description: Send the Discord toggle-deafen shortcut (best-effort; cannot confirm the resulting state).

commands.name: check-voice-control-status
commands.title: Check Voice Control Status
commands.subtitle: Discord
commands.description: Check whether the extension is ready to attempt mute/deafen toggles.

preferences.name: muteShortcut
preferences.title: Mute Shortcut
preferences.description: Discord in-app keybind for Toggle Mute. Must match your Discord keybind. Format: cmd+shift+m.

preferences.name: deafenShortcut
preferences.title: Deafen Shortcut
preferences.description: Discord in-app keybind for Toggle Deafen. Must match your Discord keybind. Format: cmd+shift+d.

preferences.name: diagnosticLogging
preferences.title: Diagnostics
preferences.label: Enable local diagnostic logging
preferences.description: Write sanitized, local-only diagnostic logs to the extension support folder. No content or secrets are logged. Off by default.

scripts.quality: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run test
